scenario: Cancel a duplicate rebate queue item only after reconciliation, packet, incident, and operations notes all point to the same late-stage queue cleanup outcome.
user_instruction: Please finish the rebate-queue cleanup for transfer TR-6610. Start from reconciliation note RC-661, then use invoice packet IV-661, prior incident note PI-661, ops follow-up OP-661, transfer policy TR-6610, fee breakdown TR-6610, and approval AP-661. If those records still converge on the same duplicate queued item, complete only the queue-removal step.

finance_reconciliation_notes.body_text: Reconciliation note RC-661. Duplicate rebate settlement remains open on account ACC-6610. Remove the duplicate queued item only if packet IV-661, prior incident PI-661, and ops follow-up OP-661 still point to the same pending id.

finance_invoice_packet_texts.body_text: Invoice packet IV-661. The duplicate rebate queue entry under review is pending transfer PTX-661B on account ACC-6610.

finance_prior_incident_notes.body_text: Prior incident PI-661. Last quarter the duplicate rebate queue on ACC-6610 was resolved by cancelling the duplicate pending instruction, not by altering the primary recipient lane.

finance_ops_followup_messages.body_text: Ops follow-up OP-661. Current duplicate review still targets PTX-661B for removal if policy and approval remain aligned.

finance_transfer_policies.body_text: Transfer policy TR-6610. If packet, reconciliation, and approval evidence still identify one duplicate queued rebate, close the issue by cancelling that queued transfer.

finance_fee_breakdowns.body_text: Fee breakdown TR-6610. No execution fee has posted on the duplicate queued rebate.

finance_approval_memos.body_text: Approval AP-661. Duplicate rebate queue cleanup is approved for pending transfer PTX-661B.
